questions.question: Is the ordinary path clear?
questions.evidence: Visible seven-step setup, obvious Next, explicit disk selection, real installed restart and Files locations.

questions.question: Is it convenient?
questions.evidence: Prepared blank-disk VMware package; no network, terminal syntax or guest driver installer needed.

questions.question: Is it user friendly?
questions.evidence: Existing disk erasure remains separately confirmed; matching ISO retained restart and two detached boots verified.

questions.question: Is the native graphics result coherent?
questions.evidence: VMware Files movement restores exposed background and window edges; native cached versus full repaint is compared independently.

questions.question: Is essential text readable?
questions.evidence: Real ordinary-resolution installer/Files and actual 3840x2160 Windows Apps use shared measured antialiased typography; reviewed captures show no essential text overlap.

limits: Agent scenario and screenshot review; no child/older-adult human study
Not a monitor FPS measurement or universal GPU/physical-hardware claim
